# Anbennar Overhaul: Enchantment spells whose choice is made in the interaction window (send options), so they are
# hand-written rather than generated by tools/build_spells.py. Both are hostile: the generated cast rolls
# aov_spell_land_chance and runs the data's effect (aov_thoughtweave_apply, aov_dominate_apply) on a hit.
# The AI block copies build_spells.HOSTILE_AI; with no option chosen the spell takes a hook.

aov_thoughtweave_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_spells
	common_interaction = no
	desc = aov_thoughtweave_interaction_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { aov_is_mage = yes }
		NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { aov_spell_thoughtweave_castable = yes }
		scope:recipient = { aov_spell_target_allowed = yes }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = aov_tw_hook
		localization = aov_tw_hook_option
	}
	send_option = {
		is_valid = {
			scope:recipient = { can_set_relation_friend_trigger = { CHARACTER = scope:actor } }
		}
		flag = aov_tw_friend
		localization = aov_tw_friend_option
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = aov_tw_lover
		localization = aov_tw_lover_option
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = aov_tw_rival
		localization = aov_tw_rival_option
	}
	send_options_exclusive = yes

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = { aov_spell_thoughtweave_cast = yes }
	}

	auto_accept = yes

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = scripted_relations
		ai_recipients = primary_war_enemies
	}
	ai_frequency = 12

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 60
			aov_spell_ai_hostile_target = yes
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = { aov_spell_land_chance < 40 }
		}
	}
}

aov_dominate_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_spells
	common_interaction = no
	desc = aov_dominate_interaction_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { aov_is_mage = yes }
		NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { aov_spell_dominate_to_surrender_castable = yes }
		scope:recipient = { aov_spell_target_allowed = yes }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = aov_dom_hook
		localization = aov_dom_hook_option
	}
	send_option = {
		is_shown = { aov_dominate_surrender_possible = yes }
		flag = aov_dom_surrender
		localization = aov_dom_surrender_option
	}
	send_option = {
		is_shown = {
			scope:recipient = { any_prisoner = { always = yes } }
		}
		flag = aov_dom_free
		localization = aov_dom_free_option
	}
	send_options_exclusive = yes

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = { aov_spell_dominate_to_surrender_cast = yes }
	}

	auto_accept = yes

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = scripted_relations
		ai_recipients = primary_war_enemies
	}
	ai_frequency = 12

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 60
			aov_spell_ai_hostile_target = yes
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = { aov_spell_land_chance < 40 }
		}
	}
}
